items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: we were with Jesse Owens... So we played around... We were rehearsing down in the Braddock Hotel.

ctx.x: Well, what happened to him eventually? (Unintelligible)?

Yes, he did. Ward, we were living there when (unintelligible) I was with Tiny Bradshaw this guy named Reuben, and (unintelligible), but Jesse Owens -- who was he with -- we were with Jesse Owens, but Jesse Owens came back from the Olympics. He had taken Danny Logan's band, the trombone player, and then had a nice band. So Teddy Hill had a band up at Savoy. So most of the fellows in Danny's group, fellows that went to school, like I went to Wilberforce, lot of them went to this school; lot of them participated in…

So when Jesse came back from the Olympics, the looking agent said (unintelligible) all right, he wanted Danny's band because everybody liked what he liked, went to school, and that's what he wanted, and it was a good group. So we played around. I went over to see Ward, and we stopped in a little, old bar and grill. I see him before I go on this trip. We sat there and drank and talked. I said, I'll see you when I come back. I says, so I'll drop you a card. All the guys in the band knew him. Said, all right, Hap --…
